app.name: Speed Boy 3 (alpha)
app.long_description:
Alpha port of Initial D Arcade Stage 3 (NAOMI 2, GDS-0033).
Independent open-source project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Sega, Kodansha, Shuichi Shigeno or Nintendo. No game data or BIOS is included: you must supply your own legally obtained files.
Put gds-0033.chd, 317-0384-com.pic and a NAOMI BIOS set (naomi.zip) together in sd:/initiald3/ or usb:/initiald3/. Press 2 in the file browser to switch device.
The launcher checks the files, decrypts the game and runs it. Speed in races is still below full speed. The log is written next to boot.dol (idas3wii_log.txt).
